community-projects.about: Reviewed community projects; maintained in arkpedia-data.

projects.description: Bring operators and enemies to your desktop, with outfits, animations and an offline model library.

projects.name: Stronghold Protocol
projects.description: Play the community remake of Stronghold Protocol: Alliance, solo or with friends. English server hosted by Yuri.

projects.name: Timo’s Arknights Story Reader
projects.description: Read main stories, side stories and operator records, with a story map, reading order and progress tracking.

projects.name: Amiya.io
projects.description: Play Arknights guessing games and puzzles, browse operators and track your pulls.

projects.name: Penguin Statistics
projects.description: Compare community-reported material drop rates and stage efficiency to plan your farming.

projects.name: Myrtle.moe
projects.description: Explore operator data, synced player profiles, calculators and base planning tools.

projects.name: Krooster
projects.description: Track and share your operator roster, plan upgrades and check recruitment options.

projects.name: Sanity Gone
projects.description: Find operator guides, reviews, detailed stats and recruitment tools.

projects.name: Arknights wiki
projects.description: Look up operators, events, game mechanics and the world of Terra on the English wiki.

projects.name: PRTS
projects.description: Browse the Chinese Arknights wiki for operator data, stages, mechanics and stories.
